changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.cross_preview_1024( p_collection text, p_chashes text[], p_embedding_model text, p_tenant text ) RETURNS TABLE( chash text, topic_id bigint, similarity double precision ) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER SET plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan AS $function$ #variable_conflict use_column DECLARE v_cid bigint; BEGIN SELECT cc.collection_id INTO v_cid FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant AND cc.name = p_collection; PERFORM set_config('hnsw.iterative_scan', 'strict_order', true); PERFORM set_config('hnsw.ef_search', '400', true); PERFORM set_config('enable_seqscan', 'off', true); PERFORM set_config('enable_sort', 'off', true);
RETURN QUERY WITH batch AS ( SELECT c.chash AS b_chash, c.embedding_1024 AS b_emb, c.embedding_model AS b_model FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE c.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND c.tenant_id = p_tenant AND (c.collection_id = v_cid OR (c.collection_id IS NULL AND c.collection = p_collection AND p_collection <> '')) AND c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL AND c.chash = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT decode(x, 'hex') FROM unnest(p_chashes) x)) ), nearest AS ( SELECT encode(b.b_chash, 'hex') AS m_chash, b.b_chash AS m_chash_bytes, b.b_model AS m_model, n.n_topic_id AS m_topic_id, (1 - n.n_dist)::double precision AS m_sim FROM batch b CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ct.topic_id AS n_topic_id, (ct.embedding_1024 OPERATOR(nexus.<=>) b.b_emb) AS n_dist FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids ct WHERE ct.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND ct.tenant_id = p_tenant AND (CASE WHEN ct.collection_id IS NOT NULL AND v_cid IS NOT NULL THEN ct.collection_id <> v_cid ELSE ct.collection <> p_collection END) AND (ct.collection_id IS NULL OR ct.collection_id <> ALL (ARRAY( SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant AND cc.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND (cc.superseded_by_id IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(cc.superseded_by, '') <> '')))) AND (ct.collection_id IS NOT NULL OR ct.collection <> ALL (ARRAY( SELECT cc.name FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant AND cc.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND (cc.superseded_by_id IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(cc.superseded_by, '') <> '') AND cc.name <> ''))) AND ct.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ct.embedding_1024 OPERATOR(nexus.<=>) b.b_emb, ct.topic_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) n ) SELECT n.m_chash, n.m_topic_id, n.m_sim FROM nearest n; END; $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.stamp_chunks_on_manifest_delete() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE v_p35b_con text; -- the constraint of a unique_violation, for the retry on the id twin BEGIN -- Lock the chunk rows first, in key order: two writers that drop the last two owners of a shared -- chunk serialize here (the second blocks until the first commits, then reads its committed -- orphaned_at), and writers that share several chunks take their locks in the same order, so two -- of these triggers cannot deadlock on chunk rows. The key list is the same as the upsert's. PERFORM 1 FROM nexus.chunks c JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, collection, chash, embedding_model, max(collection_id) AS collection_id FROM old_rows GROUP BY tenant_id, collection, chash, embedding_model) o ON o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND (o.collection_id = c.collection_id OR ((o.collection_id IS NULL OR c.collection_id IS NULL) AND o.collection = c.collection AND o.collection <> '')) AND o.chash = c.chash AND o.embedding_model = c.embedding_model ORDER BY c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF c;
-- two unique keys on nexus.chunk_orphaned_at once P3.4 builds its id twin (idx_chunk_orphaned_at_id_chash_uq): the ON -- CONFLICT arbiter absorbs a race on itself only, so a racing writer's row can trip the twin as a plain 23505. Retry once -- when the 23505 is that twin (a unique index on chunk_orphaned_at over the id key's columns); anything else is raised. FOR v_p35b_try IN 1 .. 2 LOOP BEGIN -- Record the orphaning of EVERY dropped key (nexus-z0o2p.29: no last_written_at filter). A chunk already recorded within the hour is -- skipped by the DO UPDATE's WHERE. Driven from the chunk rows, so a key with no chunk (the -- foreign key would refuse it) records nothing. A key the same transaction inserts again is cleared by -- the INSERT trigger. -- RDR-225: the orphaned-at row carries the chunk's embedding_model (the four-column chunk foreign key); -- its own primary key, and so this arbiter, stays (tenant_id, collection, chash). INSERT INTO nexus.chunk_orphaned_at AS q (tenant_id, collection, chash, orphaned_at, embedding_model, collection_id) SELECT c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash, now(), c.embedding_model, COALESCE(c.collection_id, (SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND cc.name = c.collection)) FROM nexus.chunks c JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, collection, chash, embedding_model, max(collection_id) AS collection_id FROM old_rows GROUP BY tenant_id, collection, chash, embedding_model) o ON o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND (o.collection_id = c.collection_id OR ((o.collection_id IS NULL OR c.collection_id IS NULL) AND o.collection = c.collection AND o.collection <> '')) AND o.chash = c.chash AND o.embedding_model = c.embedding_model ORDER BY c.tenant_id, c.collection, c.chash ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, collection, chash) DO UPDATE SET orphaned_at = EXCLUDED.orphaned_at, collection_id = EXCLUDED.collection_id WHERE q.orphaned_at < now() - interval '1 hour'; EXIT; EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_p35b_con = CONSTRAINT_NAME; IF v_p35b_try = 2 OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class ic JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid = ic.relnamespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = ic.oid WHERE ns.nspname = 'nexus' AND ic.relname = v_p35b_con AND ix.indisunique AND coalesce(pg_catalog.pg_partition_root(ix.indrelid), ix.indrelid) = 'nexus.chunk_orphaned_at'::regclass AND (SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(a.attname::text ORDER BY a.attname) FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = ix.indrelid AND a.attnum = ANY (ix.indkey)) = ARRAY['chash', 'collection_id', 'tenant_id']) THEN RAISE; END IF; END; END LOOP; RETURN NULL; END; $function$;

changeSet.sql: -- Fix round (linda 2026-11-23, the 5x80k remeasures): r3's body kept. Its callers pass the tenant and collection as constants, so -- each registry read is an InitPlan, once per statement; a body that reads the id in a FROM subquery made the planner run the -- orphaned_at age check before the manifest NOT EXISTS, 80,000 probes for 4,000 (fixed3), so it is not used. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.chunk_is_reapable( p_tenant text, p_collection text, p_chash bytea, p_last_written_at timestamptz, p_grace interval DEFAULT NULL ) RETURNS TABLE(reapable boolean) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ SELECT true WHERE GREATEST( p_last_written_at, -- A scalar subquery on an index probe ((tenant_id, chash), P3.3c's child index, or the primary key): the -- id-or-name match can name two records of one chunk during the stamp, so the latest is taken by -- ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1: one row, as an aggregate would give, read straight from the record. (SELECT o.orphaned_at FROM nexus.chunk_orphaned_at o WHERE o.tenant_id = p_tenant AND (o.collection_id = (SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant AND cc.name = p_collection) OR (o.collection_id IS NULL AND o.collection = p_collection AND p_collection <> '')) AND o.chash = p_chash ORDER BY o.orphaned_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) ) < now() - COALESCE(p_grace, interval '30 days') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant AND (m.collection_id = (SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant AND cc.name = p_collection) OR (m.collection_id IS NULL AND m.collection = p_collection AND p_collection <> '')) AND m.chash = p_chash ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant AND cc.name = p_collection AND cc.lifecycle_state = 'quarantine' ) $$;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.clear_orphaned_on_manifest_insert() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN -- A chunk key this statement inserted has an owner: its orphaning record, if any, is no longer true. The -- record rows are locked in key order first (the order the stamp upserts take them in), then deleted. A -- record another transaction wrote and has not committed is invisible here and may commit on an owned -- chunk: harmless (an owned chunk is not reapable) and refreshed by the next drop. Tenant equality in the -- join: the only barrier for a role that bypasses RLS. Never touches nexus.chunks. PERFORM 1 FROM nexus.chunk_orphaned_at q JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id, collection, collection_id, chash FROM new_rows) n ON n.tenant_id = q.tenant_id AND (n.collection_id = q.collection_id OR ((n.collection_id IS NULL OR q.collection_id IS NULL) AND n.collection = q.collection AND n.collection <> '')) AND n.chash = q.chash ORDER BY q.tenant_id, q.collection, q.chash FOR UPDATE OF q; DELETE FROM nexus.chunk_orphaned_at q USING (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id, collection, collection_id, chash FROM new_rows) n WHERE n.tenant_id = q.tenant_id AND (n.collection_id = q.collection_id OR ((n.collection_id IS NULL OR q.collection_id IS NULL) AND n.collection = q.collection AND n.collection <> '')) AND n.chash = q.chash; RETURN NULL; END; $function$;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.manifest_verify(p_doc_id text) RETURNS TABLE( referenced bigint, present bigint, missing bigint ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ WITH manifest AS ( SELECT c.chash, c.collection, c.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks c JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = c.doc_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND c.doc_id = p_doc_id AND c.collection IS NOT NULL ), checked AS ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks k WHERE k.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND (k.collection_id = m.collection_id OR ((k.collection_id IS NULL OR m.collection_id IS NULL) AND k.collection = m.collection AND k.collection <> '')) AND k.chash = m.chash ) AS is_present FROM manifest m ) SELECT count(*)::bigint AS referenced, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_present)::bigint AS present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_present)::bigint AS missing FROM checked $$;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.quarantine_reattach_plan( p_tenant_id text, p_origin_collection text, p_quarantine_collection text, p_chashes text[], p_from_quarantine boolean ) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $plan$ WITH reg AS ( -- RDR-229 P3.5b: the registry ids of the two labels the caller passes, read once (label-kept registry reads). SELECT (SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND cc.name = p_origin_collection) AS o_id, (SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND cc.name = p_quarantine_collection) AS q_id ), cand AS ( -- One row per named chash that exists in the origin or (p_from_quarantine, the dry run) in this origin's -- quarantine sibling. The origin row's metadata wins: a present chunk is judged by what the origin holds. SELECT r.h AS chash, decode(r.h, 'hex') AS chash_b, COALESCE(o.metadata, q.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS meta FROM unnest(p_chashes) AS r(h) LEFT JOIN nexus.chunks o ON o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (o.collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (o.collection_id IS NULL AND o.collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> '')) AND o.chash = decode(r.h, 'hex') LEFT JOIN nexus.chunks q ON p_from_quarantine AND q.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (q.collection_id = (SELECT reg.q_id FROM reg) OR (q.collection_id IS NULL AND q.collection = p_quarantine_collection AND p_quarantine_collection <> '')) AND q.chash = decode(r.h, 'hex') AND COALESCE(q.metadata->>'origin_collection', p_origin_collection) = p_origin_collection WHERE o.chash IS NOT NULL OR q.chash IS NOT NULL ), keyed AS ( SELECT c.*, NULLIF(COALESCE(NULLIF(c.meta->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(c.meta->>'doc_id', '')), '') AS fwd_key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (m.collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (m.collection_id IS NULL AND m.collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> '')) AND m.chash = c.chash_b) AS owned FROM cand c ), fwd AS ( -- The forward owner: a LIVE document anywhere in the tenant (the census's precedence: a live forward owner -- wins even when it is registered under another collection, in which case the chunk is not ours to attach). SELECT k.chash, d.tumbler, d.title, d.physical_collection, d.physical_collection_id, d.chunk_count, d.index_state, d.index_content_hash AS doc_hash FROM keyed k JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND d.tumbler = k.fwd_key AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ), rev_all AS ( SELECT k.chash, d.tumbler, d.title, d.chunk_count, d.index_state, d.index_content_hash AS doc_hash FROM keyed k JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (d.physical_collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (d.physical_collection_id IS NULL AND d.physical_collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> '')) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(d.file_path, '') = '' AND d.metadata->>'doc_id' = k.chash WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fwd f WHERE f.chash = k.chash) ), rev AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.chash) a.chash, a.tumbler, a.title, a.chunk_count, a.index_state, a.doc_hash, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.chash) AS n FROM rev_all a ORDER BY a.chash, a.tumbler ), own AS ( SELECT f.chash, f.tumbler, f.title, f.chunk_count, f.index_state, f.doc_hash, 'forward'::text AS path, COALESCE(f.physical_collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (f.physical_collection_id IS NULL AND f.physical_collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> ''), false) AS in_origin, 1::bigint AS n FROM fwd f UNION ALL SELECT v.chash, v.tumbler, v.title, v.chunk_count, v.index_state, v.doc_hash, 'reverse'::text, true, v.n FROM rev v ), placed AS ( SELECT k.chash, k.chash_b, k.meta, k.owned, o.tumbler, o.title, o.chunk_count, o.index_state, o.doc_hash, o.path, o.in_origin, o.n, CASE WHEN o.tumbler IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN o.path = 'forward' AND k.meta->>'chunk_index' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (k.meta->>'chunk_index')::integer WHEN COALESCE(o.chunk_count, 0) <= 1 THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS pos FROM keyed k LEFT JOIN own o ON o.chash = k.chash ), rival_rows AS MATERIALIZED ( -- Every OTHER chunk, in the origin or in ANY quarantine collection that holds chunks tagged for this origin, -- whose forward key names one of the documents being judged, whichever path (forward or reverse) placed the -- chunk on it: the stored versions of the document, not only the chashes this call names. Two chunks that claim -- one (document, position) are two versions of it, and a call that took only one of them (a 1000-row page -- boundary, a second call, the other sibling) must still see the other. A single-chunk legacy note (reverse -- path, position 0) is judged the same way: a keyed chunk that names the note at position 0 (or, the note -- registering at most one chunk, at no position) is its rival. The origin and p_quarantine_collection are -- scanned as before (an untagged chunk there is taken for this origin's); any OTHER quarantine collection of -- the tenant counts only for a chunk whose origin_collection tag names this origin, so a chunk of another -- origin in a shared sibling is no rival. One scan of the origin and the siblings. SELECT x.chash AS x_chash, COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')) AS x_key, x.metadata->>'chunk_index' AS x_ci FROM nexus.chunks x WHERE x.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (x.collection_id IN ((SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg), (SELECT reg.q_id FROM reg)) OR (x.collection_id IS NULL AND ((x.collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> '') OR (x.collection = p_quarantine_collection AND p_quarantine_collection <> '')))) AND COALESCE(x.metadata->>'origin_collection', p_origin_collection) = p_origin_collection AND COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')) IN (SELECT pp.tumbler FROM placed pp WHERE pp.tumbler IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL -- The other quarantine collections, one indexed probe per collection (a join, not an OR, so the collection -- index is used); a chunk counts only when its own tag names this origin. SELECT x.chash, COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')), x.metadata->>'chunk_index' FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc JOIN nexus.chunks x ON x.tenant_id = cc.tenant_id AND (x.collection_id = cc.collection_id OR (x.collection_id IS NULL AND x.collection = cc.name AND cc.name <> '')) WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND cc.lifecycle_state = 'quarantine' AND cc.name <> p_quarantine_collection AND x.metadata->>'origin_collection' = p_origin_collection AND COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')) IN (SELECT pp.tumbler FROM placed pp WHERE pp.tumbler IS NOT NULL) ), judged AS ( SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.owned THEN 'owned' WHEN p.tumbler IS NULL OR p.n <> 1 OR NOT p.in_origin THEN 'no_live_owner' -- The document's own state decides before its position does: a document that is mid index run, or -- stamped complete, has a manifest that is authoritative for its text (a complete stamp is verified -- against the manifest, so a manifest-less chunk of it is stale by definition, and a document -- emptied on purpose reads chunk_count 0 and complete). Legacy documents are unstamped. WHEN p.index_state = 'indexing' THEN 'superseded:indexing' WHEN p.index_state = 'complete' THEN 'superseded:complete' -- An index run that FAILED (CatalogRepository.failIndexRun) leaves whatever manifest it had written: -- partial, and unknown to this function. Refuse rather than guess, as for a mid-run document. WHEN p.index_state = 'failed' THEN 'superseded:failed' WHEN p.pos IS NULL THEN 'no_position' -- The chunk records the content hash of the file version it was cut from; a document that has -- since been indexed from other content records a different one. WHEN NULLIF(p.meta->>'content_hash', '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(p.doc_hash, '') IS NOT NULL AND p.meta->>'content_hash' <> p.doc_hash THEN 'superseded:version' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.doc_id = p.tumbler AND m.position = p.pos) THEN 'superseded:position_taken' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rival_rows r WHERE r.x_key = p.tumbler AND r.x_chash <> p.chash_b AND (CASE WHEN r.x_ci ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN r.x_ci::integer WHEN COALESCE(p.chunk_count, 0) <= 1 THEN 0 END) = p.pos) THEN 'superseded:rival' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.doc_id = p.tumbler AND NOT COALESCE(m.collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (m.collection_id IS NULL AND m.collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> ''), false)) THEN 'superseded:other_collection' WHEN p.path = 'reverse' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.doc_id = p.tumbler) THEN 'superseded:has_rows' WHEN COALESCE(p.chunk_count, 0) > 0 AND p.pos >= p.chunk_count THEN 'superseded:past_end' ELSE 'attach' END AS v FROM placed p ) SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'chash', j.chash, 'verdict', split_part(j.v, ':', 1), 'why', NULLIF(split_part(j.v, ':', 2), ''), 'doc', CASE WHEN j.n = 1 THEN j.tumbler END, 'title', CASE WHEN j.n = 1 THEN j.title END, 'pos', j.pos, 'chunk_title', NULLIF(j.meta->>'title', ''), 'ls', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'line_start' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'line_start')::integer END, 'le', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'line_end' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'line_end')::integer END, 'cs', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'chunk_start_char' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'chunk_start_char')::integer END, 'ce', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'chunk_end_char' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'chunk_end_char')::integer END ) ORDER BY j.chash), '[]'::jsonb) FROM judged j; $plan$;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.taxonomy_coverage_counts_1024(p_collection text) RETURNS TABLE(has_taxonomy boolean, chunks bigint, unassigned bigint) LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $function$ WITH reg AS ( -- RDR-229 P3.5b: the registry id of the label passed in, read once (label-kept registry read) SELECT (SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND cc.name = p_collection) AS id ), has_tax AS ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.taxonomy_centroids ct WHERE (ct.collection_id = (SELECT reg.id FROM reg) OR (ct.collection_id IS NULL AND ct.collection = p_collection AND p_collection <> '')) AND ct.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL ) AS v ), keyed AS ( -- the collection's chunks at this dimension SELECT c.tenant_id, c.chash, 1 AS is_chunk, 0 AS is_owned, 0 AS is_assigned FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE (c.collection_id = (SELECT reg.id FROM reg) OR (c.collection_id IS NULL AND c.collection = p_collection AND p_collection <> '')) AND c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT v FROM has_tax) UNION ALL -- chunk_live_owners' predicate (vectors-018), read once for the collection: a manifest row whose document -- is not tombstoned SELECT m.tenant_id, m.chash, 0, 1, 0 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id WHERE (m.collection_id = (SELECT reg.id FROM reg) OR (m.collection_id IS NULL AND m.collection = p_collection AND p_collection <> '')) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (SELECT v FROM has_tax) UNION ALL -- an assignment to a topic of this collection (projection rows onto other collections' topics do not count) SELECT ta.tenant_id, ta.doc_id, 0, 0, 1 FROM nexus.topic_assignments ta JOIN nexus.topics t ON t.tenant_id = ta.tenant_id AND t.id = ta.topic_id WHERE (t.collection_id = (SELECT reg.id FROM reg) OR (t.collection_id IS NULL AND t.collection = p_collection AND p_collection <> '')) AND (SELECT v CREATE OR REPLACE of the view body, one column appended at the end, same volatility, security and grants. It outputs the registry's label for a stamped row's id (nexus.catalog_collections.name by collection_id; the row's own name where the row carries no id, so a half-stamped collection is still one row) and a trailing collection_id column (the registry's id; a row with no id takes the id of the registry row its name names, so a half-stamped collection is one group), so P3.7's one-row rename shows at once and P3.5c can join by the id. CREATE OR REPLACE appends the column at the end and changes nothing before it. The rollback DROPs the view and restores the last definer's text and its PUBLIC grant, because CREATE OR REPLACE cannot drop a column. DATA EFFECT: none; no row is read or written.
changeSet.sql: -- Fix round (linda 2026-11-23, the 5x80k EXPLAIN): three UNION ALL branches by the shape of a chunk's collection (stamped, -- unstamped and registered, unstamped and unregistered or named ''), so the output id is a plain column of each branch, and a -- caller's WHERE collection_id = N (the readers filter by id, before the latch too: linda's (iii)) reaches the chunks key and, -- through the join's equalities, the manifest's id index (P3.4's idx_catalog_chunks_collection_id) in every branch; the one -- stamped branch is one scan of the chunks. A filter on the label still selects the right rows, but only the unstamped branches -- serve it by key. It stays set-based (nexus-mz9jv): the manifest is LEFT JOINed, the id arm and the name arm apart, never -- probed per chunk, and a chunk that two live manifest rows hold is counted once (count(DISTINCT chash)). CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.collection_vector_stats WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT s.tenant_id, s.collection, s.dim, count(DISTINCT s.chash) FILTER (WHERE s.live) AS chunk_count, max(s.created_at) FILTER (WHERE s.live) AS last_write, count(DISTINCT s.chash) AS stored_count, s.collection_id FROM ( -- 1. stamped: the registry's label for the row's id, else (no registry row holds it) the row's own name; callers filter -- by collection_id (linda's (iii)), which pushes onto c.collection_id here, so one scan of the stamped chunks serves both SELECT c.tenant_id, COALESCE(r.name, c.collection) AS collection, c.collection_id AS collection_id, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim, c.chash, c.created_at, (mi.chash IS NOT NULL OR mn.chash IS NOT NULL) AS live FROM nexus.chunks c LEFT JOIN nexus.catalog_collections r ON r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND r.collection_id = c.collection_id LEFT JOIN (nexus.catalog_document_chunks mi JOIN nexus.catalog_documents di ON di.tenant_id = mi.tenant_id AND di.tumbler = mi.doc_id AND di.deleted_at IS NULL) ON mi.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND mi.collection_id = c.collection_id AND mi.chash = c.chash LEFT JOIN (nexus.catalog_document_chunks mn JOIN nexus.catalog_documents dn ON dn.tenant_id = mn.tenant_id AND dn.tumbler = mn.doc_id AND dn.deleted_at IS NULL) ON mn.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND mn.chash = c.chash AND mn.collection = c.collection AND c.collection <> '' AND mn.collection_id IS NULL WHERE c.collection_id IS changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.24
changeSet.comment: RDR-229 P3.5b (nexus-p2m1x.24), form B: nexus.live_chunks reads both shapes of the collection name, the id where both sides carry one and the name where either lacks one (a NULL id never matches through a '' name). CREATE OR REPLACE of the view body, one column appended at the end, same volatility, security and grants. It outputs the registry's label for a stamped row's id (nexus.catalog_collections.name by collection_id; the row's own name where the row carries no id) and a trailing collection_id column, so P3.7's one-row rename shows at once. CREATE OR REPLACE appends the column at the end and changes nothing before it. The rollback DROPs the view and restores the last definer's text and its PUBLIC grant, because CREATE OR REPLACE cannot drop a column. DATA EFFECT: none; no row is read or written.
changeSet.sql: -- Fix round (linda 2026-11-23): r3's body kept. On 5x80k a one-collection LIMIT 100 page reads 2.48 ms / 3,012 hits against -- 1.03 ms before; the UNION ALL split tried in b6ff7a3cb7 built a hashed SubPlan over the tenant's whole manifest (3,241 ms). CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW nexus.live_chunks WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT c.tenant_id, COALESCE(r.name, c.collection) AS collection, c.chash, c.chunk_text, COALESCE(c.embedding_384, c.embedding_768, c.embedding_1024)::nexus.vector AS embedding, c.chunk_tsv, c.metadata, c.created_at, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim, c.collection_id FROM nexus.chunks c LEFT JOIN nexus.catalog_collections r ON r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND r.collection_id = c.collection_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id WHERE m.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND m.chash = c.chash AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (c.collection_id = m.collection_id OR ((c.collection_id IS NULL OR m.collection_id IS NULL) AND c.collection = m.collection AND c.collection <> '')));

END IF; RETURN QUERY WITH g AS ( SELECT u.ch, pg_catalog.row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY u.cid) AS rn, u.cid FROM ROWS FROM (pg_catalog.unnest(v_cid), pg_catalog.unnest(v_chash)) AS u(cid, ch) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks lo JOIN nexus.catalog_documents lod ON lod.tenant_id = lo.tenant_id AND lod.tumbler = lo.doc_id WHERE lo.tenant_id = p_tenant AND lo.collection_id = u.cid AND lo.chash = u.ch AND lod.deleted_at IS NULL) ), capped AS ( SELECT g.ch, g.rn, g.cid, pg_catalog.count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g.cid) AS n FROM g WHERE g.rn <= p_cap ) SELECT (SELECT r.name FROM nexus.catalog_collections r WHERE r.tenant_id = p_tenant AND r.collection_id = x.cid), CASE WHEN x.n < p_cap THEN x.ch END, x.cid FROM capped x WHERE x.n < p_cap OR x.rn = p_cap; END $$$f$; END $do$; DO $acl$ DECLARE v_orig pg_catalog.regprocedure := 'nexus.text_gate_probe_by_collection_768(text,text[],jsonb,text,int,text,text)'::pg_catalog.regprocedure; v_twin pg_catalog.regprocedure := 'nexus.text_gate_probe_by_collection_768_by_id(text,bigint[],jsonb,text,int,text,text)'::pg_catalog.regprocedure; v_acl pg_catalog.aclitem[]; v_owner pg_catalog.oid; r record; BEGIN SELECT p.proacl, p.proowner INTO v_acl, v_owner FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.oid = v_orig; -- the original has the default ACL (NULL): so does the twin, nothing to do IF v_acl IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF; -- PUBLIC keeps EXECUTE on the original: the twin's default ACL grants exactly as much (every role, the owner), so nothing -- is issued; each GRANT and REVOKE is a counted DDL statement (linda 2026-11-22). Only where the original revokes PUBLIC -- (the text_gate_probe and search_topic_set families) does the twin revoke it too and grant the same roles. IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(v_acl) x WHERE x.grantee = 0 AND x.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE') THEN RETURN; END IF; EXECUTE pg_catalog.format('REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC', v_twin); FOR r IN SELECT x.grantee, x.is_grantable FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(v_acl) x WHERE x.grantee NOT IN (0, v_owner) AND x.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE' ORDER BY x.grantee LOOP EXECUTE pg_catalog.format('GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %s TO %s%s', v_twin, r.grantee::pg_catalog.regrole, CASE WHEN r.is_grantable THEN ' WITH GRANT OPTION' ELSE '' END); END LOOP; END $acl$;

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.text_gate_probe_by_collection_768_by_id(text,bigint[],jsonb,text,int,text,text);

changeSet.comment: RDR-229 P3.5b: nexus.chunk_live_owners_by_id, the id twin of nexus.chunk_live_owners (linda 2026-11-22). The name function keeps its last definer (vectors-018) until P4.1: the name-path search functions inline it, and a registry lookup in its body would add a probe per HNSW candidate. Its chunk-to-manifest match is on the two rows' own name columns, which a rename leaves equal on both until P4.1 (the child name keys stay), so it stays right. The twin matches the manifest row by collection_id, for P3.5c's id readers once gate 3 has latched. Same LANGUAGE, volatility, SECURITY and EXECUTE (PUBLIC, as the original). DATA EFFECT: none.
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION nexus.chunk_live_owners_by_id( p_tenant text, p_collection_id bigint, p_chash bytea ) RETURNS TABLE(doc_id text) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ SELECT d.tumbler FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant AND m.collection_id = p_collection_id AND m.chash = p_chash AND d.deleted_at IS NULL $$;

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.chunk_live_owners_by_id(text, bigint, bytea)
